R13.condition: Full seating of the bridge and service access require a support drawing. The finished stud needs measured elongation.

R2.condition: Linear eccentric clamp check. Tension at a footprint edge means loss of full-area closure.

R3.condition: Phi calculated for the parting plane and the whole grip. M42/M45 properties and fit shall be guaranteed separately.

R4.condition: Require measured total settlement and differential temperature of grip.

R5.condition: Axial residual is positive but is insufficient to prove total closure.

R8.condition: Smooth sections from a tied model. Nut seating eccentricity and local runout require qualification.

R9.condition: Axial and bending ranges on the same side. First engaged turn and runout are not resolved by the elastic surrogate.
